title: Causal Thread Loupe — interactive callchain exploration and pinboard
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and prototype an exploratory 'Loupe' for tracing that surfaces causal threads across services. The loupe is a lightweight, context-first panel that lets engineers pin correlated spans, follow causal edges (inferred and explicit), and pivot filters without losing timeline context. Goal: reduce time-to-root-cause for multi-hop failures and noisy tails while keeping the main trace list uncluttered.
acceptance_criteria: Loupe prototype (Figma) demonstrates pinning 3 spans from different services while preserving original timeline context
Loupe supports quick pivot filters (by correlation ID, service, span-name) and updates pinned view within 200ms in the prototype interactions
UX flows for saving a loupe selection as a named investigation exist (mocked) and link to incident ticket creation
Design handoff includes tokens, interaction specs, and an accessibility checklist (keyboard focus, color contrast)
design_notes: Primary affordance: ephemeral right-side 'loupe' that anchors to a selected trace row or correlation search
Visual metaphor: physical jeweller's loupe — zoomed-in selection with soft masking of unrelated spans
Two view modes: Aggregated thread (collapsed service nodes with counts) and Expanded callchain (linear timeline with causal arrows)
Pinboard lets users collect spans across traces; pinned items persist during navigation until cleared
Include lightweight causal inference badges (probable, direct, inferred) with hover explanations
We avoid replacing the existing full trace view; loupe is additive and optimized for rapid triage
tradeoffs: Detail vs. latency: showing full span payloads increases payload size and render work. Chosen compromise: show skeletons and fetch heavy payloads on expand (deferred fetch)
Auto-linking by correlation ID may surface too many noisy matches. Introduced a precision slider in prototype to tune match sensitivity
Persisting pinned spans across sessions adds storage complexity; initial MVP stores pins in browser localStorage scoped to user and project
Overlay vs. panel: overlay is more contextual but harder for lengthy investigations; chosen side-panel pattern supports deeper examination without occluding the trace list

ENG feedback 2026-03-03: rendering 1:1 causal arrows causes layout churn on large threads; recommend virtualized canvas for expanded view
Perf note 2026-03-05: aim for <200ms UI update for filter pivots; suggest debounced queries and pre-warmed caches for correlation id searches
